rationale: The tape is completely frozen — the last five 5-minute candles are all flat at $59.05 with de minimis volume and a 5-minute ATR of one cent, meaning there is no exploitable movement in either direction. With only 11 minutes to the close, any position would either be exited at a loss to the spread (costing roughly the entire one-cent ATR) or carry uncompensated overnight gap risk in a long-duration treasury ETF. The intraday fade of the opening gap is already reflected in price sitting near the session low just above VWAP, so there is no fresh mechanical signal left to act on.
